steps.title: Main tank takes Alpha Omega north
steps.rule: Main tank picks up the boss and holds it about 7m north of the centre.

steps.title: Off tank waits at waymark 2
steps.rule: Off tank waits on waymark 2 (south-east), away from the party.

steps.title: Party gathers south-west
steps.rule: Everyone but the tanks lines up together south-west of the boss, between the centre and waymark 3.

steps.title: Off tank baits from waymark 2
steps.rule: Off tank steps out to the south-east, just past waymark 2, before Cosmo Arrow.

steps.title: In first: start 9m south-west
steps.cue: Cosmo Arrow, the cross fires in the middle first
steps.rule: When the inner cross goes first, the whole party stacks south-west about 9m out, outside the cross but inside the outer lines.

steps.title: Out first: start on waymark 3
steps.cue: Cosmo Arrow, the outer pinwheel fires first
steps.rule: When the outer pinwheel goes first, the whole party stacks on waymark 3 (south-west), between the outer lines and the centre cross.

steps.title: In first: step in behind the cross
steps.rule: Once the middle cross fires, step in to about 5m south-west, onto the cells it just cleared.

steps.title: Out first: run out to the wall
steps.rule: After the first pulse, move out to the south-west wall onto the cells the outer lines already cleared.

steps.title: In first: run out to the wall
steps.rule: Run back out to the south-west wall, past waymark 3, as the lines sweep inward.

steps.title: Out first: back to waymark 3
steps.rule: Step back in to waymark 3.

steps.title: Out first: out to the wall again
steps.rule: Out to the south-west wall once more.

steps.title: Out first: settle on waymark 3
steps.rule: Back in to waymark 3 and stay there for Cosmo Dive.

steps.title: Left dive tank goes north
steps.rule: The left dive tank moves 7m north of the boss to take one Cosmo Dive buster; the party stays south-west for the stack.

steps.title: Right dive tank goes east
steps.rule: The right dive tank moves 7m east of the boss to take the other Cosmo Dive buster; the party stays south-west for the stack.

steps.title: In first: settle on waymark 3
steps.rule: Come back in to waymark 3 for Cosmo Dive.

steps.title: Main tank back north
steps.rule: Main tank returns to the boss's north side to hold autos.

steps.title: Off tank baits by the wall
steps.rule: Off tank goes out to the wall on their dive side, a little past it, to keep autos off the party.

steps.title: Gather in the middle
steps.rule: Everyone huddles tight in the centre: the first puddle drops under the whole group there.

steps.title: Puddle 1 dropped: step toward the free octant
steps.rule: Your first puddle went down in the middle. Walk about 5m out toward the free octant: the one just behind where the exaflares start, opposite the way they turn.

steps.title: Puddle 2: out to the wall
steps.rule: Run on out to the wall (15m) in that same octant and drop the next puddle there.

steps.title: Puddle 3: follow the exaflares along the wall
steps.rule: Walk along the wall about 25 degrees in the direction the exaflares turn, staying behind them.

steps.title: Puddle 4: keep walking
steps.rule: Keep following along the wall, about 55 degrees from where you reached it.

steps.title: Puddle 5: last step along the wall
steps.rule: One more step along the wall, about 90 degrees from where you reached it; the last puddle drops here.

steps.title: Puddle 1 dropped: step toward the free octant
steps.rule: Your first puddle went down in the middle. Walk about 5m out toward the free octant: the one just behind where the exaflares start, opposite the way they turn.

steps.title: Puddle 2: out to the wall
steps.rule: Run on out to the wall (15m) in that same octant and drop the next puddle there.

steps.title: Puddle 3: follow the exaflares along the wall
steps.rule: Walk along the wall about 25 degrees in the direction the exaflares turn, staying behind them.

steps.title: Puddle 4: keep walking
steps.rule: Keep following along the wall, about 55 degrees from where you reached it.

steps.title: Puddle 5: last step along the wall
steps.rule: One more step along the wall, about 90 degrees from where you reached it; the last puddle drops here.

steps.title: Head for your clock spot
steps.rule: After the last puddle, walk to your clock spot about 8m out: tanks N/S, healers W/E, melees SW/SE, ranged NE/NW.

steps.title: Protean on your clock spot
steps.rule: Stand on your clock spot about 12m out so the proteans don't overlap: MT north, OT south, H1 west, H2 east, D1 SW, D2 SE, D3 NE, D4 NW.

steps.title: Wild Charge: second tank behind
steps.rule: Line up south of the boss for Wild Charge. The tank using invuln stands first, 5m out; the other tank right behind at 7m.

steps.title: Wild Charge: invuln tank in front
steps.rule: Line up south of the boss for Wild Charge. The tank using invuln stands first, 5m out; the other tank right behind at 7m.

steps.title: Wild Charge: party in the line
steps.rule: Non-tanks stack in a tight line behind the tanks, 9-11m south of the boss.

steps.title: Main tank back north
steps.rule: Main tank returns to the boss's north side.

steps.title: Off tank baits south-east
steps.rule: Off tank goes out toward the south-east wall to bait autos away from the party.

steps.title: In first: supports beside your partner
steps.cue: Cosmo Arrow, the cross fires in the middle first
steps.rule: Supports stand 10m out between their own cardinal and their DPS partner's diagonal (MT with D3, OT with D1, H1 with D4, H2 with D2), outside the centre cross.

steps.title: In first: DPS 9m on your diagonal
steps.cue: Cosmo Arrow, the cross fires in the middle first
steps.rule: DPS stand about 9m out on their own diagonal (D1 SW, D2 SE, D3 NE, D4 NW), outside the centre cross.

steps.title: Out first: supports beside your partner
steps.cue: Cosmo Arrow, the outer pinwheel fires first
steps.rule: Supports stand 11m out between their own cardinal and their DPS partner's diagonal (MT with D3, OT with D1, H1 with D4, H2 with D2).

steps.title: Out first: DPS on your waymark
steps.cue: Cosmo Arrow, the outer pinwheel fires first
steps.rule: DPS stand on their diagonal waymark (D1 3, D2 2, D3 1, D4 4), between the pinwheel and the centre cross.

steps.title: In first: supports step in with your DPS
steps.rule: Step in to 5m on your partner's diagonal, next to them.

steps.title: In first: DPS step in
steps.rule: Step in to 5m on your diagonal onto the cells the cross just cleared.

steps.title: Out first: supports to the corner
steps.rule: Go out to the wall on your partner's diagonal, next to them.

steps.title: Out first: DPS out to the wall
steps.rule: Move out to the wall on your diagonal.

steps.title: In first: supports out to the wall
steps.rule: Run out to 13m, still between your cardinal and your partner's diagonal.

steps.title: In first: DPS out to the wall
steps.rule: Run out to the wall on your diagonal.

steps.title: Out first: supports back in
steps.rule: Step back in to 11m, between your cardinal and your partner's diagonal.

steps.title: Out first: DPS back to your waymark
steps.rule: Step back in to your diagonal waymark.

steps.title: Out first: supports onto your cardinal
steps.rule: Move onto your cardinal waymark: MT A, OT C, H1 D, H2 B.

steps.title: Out first: DPS out again
steps.rule: Out toward the wall on your diagonal again.

steps.title: In first: supports onto your cardinal
steps.rule: Move onto your cardinal waymark: MT A, OT C, H1 D, H2 B.

steps.title: Out first: supports in for the protean
steps.rule: Step in to 8m on your cardinal for the first protean.

steps.title: Out first: DPS in for the protean
steps.rule: Come back in to about 11m on your diagonal for the first protean.

steps.title: In first: supports in for the protean
steps.rule: Step in to about 9m on your cardinal for the first protean.

steps.title: In first: DPS onto your waymark
steps.rule: Come back in to your diagonal waymark (D1 3, D2 2, D3 1, D4 4) for the proteans.

steps.title: Party to the second Cosmo Dive spot
steps.rule: After the last puddle, keep going around the wall in the exaflares' direction and stack 12m out there for Cosmo Dive.

steps.title: Dive tanks to their sides
steps.rule: Tanks go 7m from the boss on the side away from the party, one to each side, so the dive busters land clear of the stack.

steps.title: Main tank opposite the party
steps.rule: Main tank takes the boss 6.5m on the side opposite the party.

steps.title: Healers step in toward the party
steps.rule: Healers drift in to about 8m on the party's side to heal up.

steps.title: Off tank baits by the wall
steps.rule: Off tank goes out to the wall on their dive side, a little past it, to bait autos.

steps.title: Healers gather in the middle
steps.rule: Healers move to the centre first to start healing for Cosmo Meteor.

steps.title: Everyone gathers in the middle
steps.rule: Everyone else joins the healers in the centre.

steps.title: Spread for Cosmo Meteor
steps.rule: Spread to your meteor spot: R1 north wall, MT NE, H2 east, D2 SE, OT south, D1 SW, H1 west, caster NW.

steps.title: Middle healer steps in
steps.rule: The middle healer steps in to about 6m from the centre on their side.

steps.title: Other healer steps in
steps.rule: The other healer steps in to 7m on their side.

steps.title: Stack north, or south if R1 is a flare
steps.rule: Everyone without a flare stacks at the north wall with R1. If R1 has a flare, R1 stays north and the stack moves to the south wall instead.

steps.title: Flares to a free cardinal
steps.rule: With a flare marker, run to the nearest free cardinal at the wall, 18m out, on a side the stack doesn't use.

steps.title: Clump under Alpha Omega
steps.rule: Everyone clumps tight under the boss.
